curricula.name: Egyptian MOE national curriculum, from official student books
curricula.note: Units and lessons copied from the contents pages of Ministry of Education and Technical Education student books hosted on the Ministry's e-learning storage. Topic titles are the book's own headings, with the book's own spelling; English titles are our translations. Generic items (speaking practice, self-assessment, lesson and unit assessments, reviews, practice repeats of an earlier topic, projects) are left out. Term 2 books are the 2025/2026 editions, the latest available. Book links come from data/catalog/sources/moe-book-links.csv.

verified.method: Read from the contents page of each linked Ministry student book; cover checked for Ministry branding, grade, and academic year.
